notes: Groundwater = Water + Groundwater subdivision (11,748 rows); 73 'Not determined' groundwater rows are neither routine nor QC and were excluded from routine counts (QC = 578 field replicates + 4 reference material). Dissolved arsenic (USGS 01000, ug/l) in routine groundwater: single parameter code, no re-expressed duplicates, (well, activity) key unique. Non-detect rows = non-empty ResultDetectionConditionText: 242 'Not Detected' + 3 'Detected Not Quantified'; none carries a numeric value, all have a limit in ug/l. Wells with 2+ samples counted by distinct sample date (490); by distinct ActivityIdentifier it is 521. 'Total' arsenic (01002, 3 rows) excluded.
checks: unique key (MonitoringLocationIdentifier, ActivityIdentifier, ResultIdentifier): 0 duplicates in 2997 rows
single USGSPCode 01000 and single unit ug/l among detected rows; no re-expressed pairs possible
censoring_profile by year: censored share 0-30%, limits vary 0.02-20 ug/L
well-level sample counts: median 2, max 23, 993 wells
caveats: Reporting limits fall ~0.2-2 ug/L (2000-04) to 0.02-0.1 (2010s), with outliers up to 20; censored share changes with limits, so detection frequency trends are confounded
